about: This is a standalone product for those who do not yet own the DOOM Eternal Standard or Deluxe Edition. Includes DOOM Eternal (BattleMode).
The Ancient Gods – Part One is the first campaign expansion for the critically acclaimed DOOM Eternal.

Your war is not over… slaying the Khan Maykr left an imbalance of power  that threatens all of creation. The legions of Hell have razed the heavens, threatening to expand their control across dimensions.
With the aid of an old ally, battle your way back to Urdak and decide the fate of the cosmos. Your mission is now your own.
Experience a new mission in your eternal fight against evil. Unleash your vengeance and face your greatest test as you march back to the Maykr’s realm.
